9. 🛠️ Developer Tools: Template orchestration, debugging, system health

FileInfo.docstring:
Information about a file being processed.

Attributes:
    filename: Name of the file
    file_path: Full path to the file
    file_size: Size of the file in bytes
    file_extension: File extension (lowercase)
    created_time: File creation timestamp
    modified_time: File modification timestamp
    mime_type: MIME type of the file
    file_hash: SHA-256 hash of the file
    content_type: Type of content (text, code, document, etc.)
    metadata: Additional metadata

FileTypeConfig.docstring:
Configuration for file type processing.

Attributes:
    extension: File extension (e.g., '.txt', '.pdf')
    content_type: Type of content (e.g., 'text', 'code', 'document')
    mime_type: MIME type of the file
    processor_name: Name of the processor method
    requires_dependencies: List of required Python packages
    max_size: Maximum file size for this type (bytes)
    enabled: Whether this file type is enabled for processing

FileTypeRegistry.docstring: Registry for managing file type configurations.

IntelligenceAnalyzer.docstring:

IngestionConfig.docstring:
Configuration for file ingestion operations.

Attributes:
    default_analysis_type: Default analysis type for ingested files
    recursive_processing: Whether to process subdirectories by default
    max_file_size: Maximum file size to process (in bytes)
    supported_extensions: List of supported file extensions
    output_directory: Directory for storing ingestion results
    enable_memory_storage: Whether to store results in memory
    enable_breakthrough_detection: Whether to detect breakthroughs
    processing_timeout: Timeout for processing operations (seconds)
    batch_size: Number of files to process in a batch
    enable_logging: Whether to enable detailed logging

ProcessingResult.docstring:
Result of file content processing.

Attributes:
    success: Whether processing was successful
    content: Extracted content from file
    metadata: Additional metadata about the content
    error: Error message if processing failed

IngestionResult.docstring:
Result of a file ingestion operation.

Attributes:
    success: Whether the ingestion was successful
    file_info: Information about the ingested file
    content_length: Length of extracted content
    analysis: Analysis results from intelligent agent
    memory_stored: Whether content was stored in memory
    breakthroughs_found: Number of breakthroughs detected
    processing_time: Time taken for processing
    error: Error message if ingestion failed
    file_path: Path to the processed file

DirectoryIngestionResult.docstring:
Result of a directory ingestion operation.

Attributes:
    success: Whether the directory ingestion was successful
    directory_path: Path to the processed directory
    files_processed: Total number of files processed
    files_successful: Number of successfully processed files
    files_failed: Number of failed files
    total_breakthroughs: Total breakthroughs found across all files
    file_results: List of individual file results
    processing_time: Total processing time
    error: Error message if directory processing failed
